title: SCIM authenticates with an interactive admin JWT; deprovision only flips directory status
test_evidence: Commits c3255fff, 72e2e89e. scim-credential.test.ts + mutating-route-authz.test.ts with the parent app.ts/tenant-admin-plugin.ts/mutating-route-authz.ts/scim-plugin.ts: 4 fail (admin JWT accepted on GET/POST /scim/v2 Users and Groups; no scim-token inventory rule) and the token suite cannot set up (no issuance route); after: 50/50 (spoofed x-tenant-id acts only on the token tenant, suspended tenant 403, admin JWT 401, revoked/unknown 401, SCIM principal 403 off /scim/v2 incl. billing/me, notifications, meta, services, SESSION_REVOKED for a token issued before a tenant-wide revocation, a later one 200); scGateSuite (mutating-route-authz, tenant-context-trust, rbac-enforcement, gateway-mount-matrix, domain-plugins, tenant-custom-roles) 164 pass unchanged
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-gateway-identity-batch1. Shipped: dedicated scim_ bearer tokens, stored only as sha256(SCIM_TOKEN_PEPPER, token) in control_plane_documents gateway.scim_tokens (tenant-owned, subject-first platformAdmin lookup, timingSafeEqual); POST/DELETE /api/v1/tenant/scim-token (issue-or-rotate / revoke, tenant admin via exact {user: manage} overrides, raw token shown once, no-store); /scim/v2 never accepts a JWT; DR4-1 credential branch right after the RBAC 401 (no self-service/utility/portal/platform-area exits). Deployed boots need SCIM_TOKEN_PEPPER (>=32 chars, not JWT_SECRET) or refuse to start. Unmet step: deprovision session revocation. The SCIM directory record (tenant.users via RolesService) and the login identity (auth users / keycloak_identities) are separate records with no id link, and access-token-revocation.ts has no per-subject kind; revoking the deprovisioned person's sessions needs that link (e.g. tenant + email match) plus a per-subject revocation entry. Rollout: existing IdP SCIM connectors that send an admin JWT get 401 and must be re-configured with an issued SCIM token.

title: Public /auth/mfa/otp/send trusts client tenantId/userId/phone; challenge not bound to a login
test_evidence: Commit ecf14d59. With the parent mfa-routes.ts/routes.ts/app.ts: auth 4 fail (ticket not honoured on send, verify unbound, no ticket minted at login) and gateway 2 fail (gateway-signed ticket refused 401 since no binding is mounted; verify without a ticket not refused); after: auth 28/28, gateway wiring + auth-audit 23/23
notes: Topic 1 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-gateway-identity-batch1. Shipped: HMAC pre-MFA ticket (MFA_PRE_TICKET_SECRET, never JWT_SECRET; deployed: >=32 chars and != JWT_SECRET or boot refused, unset = tickets disabled so send stays 401) required by /auth/mfa/otp/send and /auth/mfa/verify; verify rejects a challenge of another login (MFA_BINDING_MISMATCH); body tenantId/userId/phone ignored; the gateway mounts both MFA route sets with it; the local login handler mints the ticket when an MFA policy requires it. Unmet steps: (1) the gateway's Keycloak /password handler does not mint the ticket (its PRC-H043 mfaToken hold flow applies when mfaPolicy is wired, which app.ts does not do); (2) the gateway has no server-side phone source (resolvePhone), so a ticket-bound send stops at 400 MFA_PHONE_UNAVAILABLE instead of texting; (3) no completion-ticket redeemer exists, so issueCompletionTicket stays unwired.

title: No per-identifier throttle or bot control on anonymous submit and tracking-status endpoints
test_evidence: Commit 7b03481f. With the parent routes.ts/public-throttle.ts/registration-access.ts and portal api.ts/error-messages.ts: backend 11 fail (deployed submit accepted without a challenge; no challenge route; no default verifier: bad HMAC / expired / under-worked / replayed / foreign-tenant tokens not refused; deployed boot not refused without secret or Redis) and portal 3 fail (submit sends no solved challenge); after: backend 15/15, portal 5/5, gateway contract (portal client solves the real backend challenge, deployed submit 201; unchallenged 400 CHALLENGE_REQUIRED) 2/2; registration 207 pass, portal 83 pass
notes: Topic 2 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-gateway-identity-batch1. Shipped: self-hosted HMAC proof-of-work (no third party, no visual CAPTCHA): GET /registrations/challenge (public, per-tenant issuance limiter) issues {nonce, difficulty, expiresAt, sig=HMAC(REGISTRATION_CHALLENGE_SECRET, nonce|difficulty|expiresAt|tenant)}; the portal solves it with WebCrypto and sends x-registration-challenge (forwarded by the same-origin proxy); submit verifies signature, expiry, work (server minimum) and single use via Redis SET NX EX (memory only outside deployed envs). Required by default when deployed; deployed + required without secret (>=32, != JWT_SECRET) or Redis refuses registration plugin boot. Unmet steps: bot control / per-identifier throttle on the anonymous tracking-status lookups beyond the existing per-tracking-number limiter, a per-identifier submit throttle, and replica-shared status limiters (still in-process). Rollout: deployed environments must supply REGISTRATION_CHALLENGE_SECRET and REDIS_URL.
